provenance_note: R26-306 intake (2026-09-24). Part (c) of E99 s115, customers' spend on NVIDIA, as FILED. 'Hyperscale' is NVIDIA's own platform label (recast in Q1 FY27; one company moved into it in Q2) - not a list of named companies. The 10-Q also says one AI research and deployment company 'contributed a meaningful amount of our revenue by purchasing cloud services from our customers' - money that reaches NVIDIA through the clouds, never put in a number. The Gemini reply's '35-40% of hyperscaler capex' and '>50-75% of compute capex' (Dell'Oro URL 404, Goldman URL 403) are UNSOURCED and are not in this object.
